attachments.text:
6 years 365Talents!

I used to change jobs every two years...So why did I stay?
When I joined this startup, I heard warnings from acquaintances:
 “Too small for you.”
 “Not international enough.”
 “You’ll get bored in 18 months — like every CMO.”

Six years later, the story is very different.

The company grew. We scaled. 

And somehow, that evolution feels very familiar: we now have an international mindset, a global ambition… with a French grounding. 

What I loved on day one is still what fuels me today: its Talents!

Loïc Michel :gem:, Mathieu MARTIN, Paul Mougel the brilliant founders and musketeers (that I'm still trying to rebrand as MarMiMou)

The brilliant minds Lou Fedon, Elliott Tessier, Eric Janin, the other VPs and Juliette Guillou who are the other members of our exec team (and it's such a privilege to be working with the same brilliant crowd for more than 6 years now)

My Marketing Superheroes Saila Nieminen, Camille Antunes, María Angélica Salazar, Cynthia Garcia, Joanna Gittens...

And all our Talents! The list is long, but I’m grateful every single day to work with such an amazing team 🩷 

Over these six years, I’ve never stopped learning — about HR, AI, skills, and how technology can truly transform work. And honestly, I feel like there’s still so much more to learn, explore, and say.

So what do I wish for year seven?

- More marketing breakthroughs by making B2B less “boring to boring”
- Bold campaigns — and shared wins, of course
- Plenty of laughter (the best KPI to measure whether you enjoy your work)
- And to keep cherishing that rare connection that makes the journey truly meaningful
